en.headline: Ferry collides with floating dock off Tsing Yi oil depot, 24 injured
en.dek: Police said a passenger ferry from Sheung Wan to Shekou struck a floating dock around 9:25am, leaving 24 people injured including four in serious condition.
body: A passenger ferry collided with a floating dock in the waters off the Tsing Yi oil depot on Friday morning, injuring 24 people, police said. Four of the injured were in serious condition.

The force said it received a report at about 9:25am. The vessel, which had departed Sheung Wan en route to Shekou in Shenzhen, struck the dock near Tsing Yi. Fire Services Department crews deployed fireboats and a mobile casualty treatment centre, and a large number of ambulances responded to the scene.

All the injured were conscious and were taken to Princess Margaret Hospital and Yan Chai Hospital for treatment, according to reports. The boat was later towed to a maintenance facility. Police are investigating the cause of the collision.

zh.headline: 上環往蛇口客輪青衣油庫對開撞浮船塢 24人受傷
zh.dek: 警方表示，一艘由上環前往蛇口的客輪約上午9時25分在青衣油庫對開海域撞及浮船塢，造成24人受傷，其中4人情況嚴重。
body: 警方表示，一艘客輪星期五上午在青衣油庫對開海域撞及浮船塢，造成24人受傷，其中4人情況嚴重。
警方指，約上午9時25分接報。該船由上環開出，前往深圳蛇口，在青衣附近撞及船塢。消防處派出消防船及流動傷亡處理中心，大批救護車到場救援。
據報所有傷者均清醒，已送往瑪嘉烈醫院及仁濟醫院治理。船隻其後被拖往維修設施。警方正調查意外原因。
